description: This source file contains C code related to network VLAN configuration for different switch types (external, WiFi, internal switch), including functions for adding/removing VLANs and handling switch port configurations. It also includes some external variable declarations, macro definitions, and utility functions for port ID string conversions.

methods.name: int configVlan_ESW(PSWFabHALArg args,int numArgs,BOOL up)
methods.description: Configures VLANs for external switches, invoking scripts or functions to add or remove VLANs based on the parameter 'up'.

methods.name: int configVlan_WiFi(PSWFabHALArg args,int numArgs,BOOL up)
methods.description: Configures VLANs for WiFi interfaces, calling scripts or functions to add or remove VLANs accordingly.

methods.name: int stringIDIntSw(void * portID,char * stringbuf,int bufSize)
methods.description: Converts internal switch portID to a string representation.

methods.name: int eventIDSw(void * portID,char * stringbuf,int bufSize)
methods.description: Retrieves event ID from internal switch portID.

methods.name: int stringIDExtSw(void * portID,char * stringbuf,int bufSize)
methods.description: Converts external switch portID to a string representation.

methods.name: int configVlan_ISW(PSWFabHALArg args,int numArgs,BOOL up)
methods.description: Configures VLANs for internal switch ports, adding or removing VLANs based on 'up' parameter.
